clips.title: The story
paras: Dragonmaw Shinbones is a Horde warrior quest directed by the armorer Velora Nitely in the Undercity. To craft the resilient Brutal Legguards, warriors are dispatched into the southern Wetlands to harvest exceptionally thick shinbones from the hostile Dragonmaw orcs.

Forging armor fit for a seasoned frontline warrior demands unorthodox materials. When tasked with fashioning Brutal Legguards, the Forsaken armorer Velora Nitely specifies a structural brace constructed from thick, resilient bone. Rather than utilizing common beasts, she directs aspiring warriors toward the Dragonmaw orcs of the Wetlands, whose dense skeletal builds provide the necessary resilience to withstand heavy blows in combat.

Harvesting bone from the Dragonmaw is only half the ordeal. Velora instructs warriors to manually test every bone taken in the field; any specimen brittle enough to snap in bare hands is utterly useless for the forge. Warriors must scour the renegade encampments along the Wetlands' crags, breaking weak bones until eight genuinely sturdy examples survive the test of strength.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: To make the brutal leg guards, I need a brace of sturdy shinbones. The Dragonmaw orcs of the Wetlands have nice, thick shinbones. I'll need theirs.
But they must be sturdy. Be sure to test the shinbones as you collect them. If you can break them with your bare hands, then they won't be sturdy enough to work with.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I'm waiting for those shinbones, friend. They'll make a nice frame for your leg guards.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Well done! These all look strong. I think they'll do quite nicely. How did those orcs mind you taking their shins, friend? Complain much?
That was another joke. You're not laughing.
I'm not very funny these days, am I...
